title: Croatian Cheese Lasagna
description: A hearty Italian-inspired dish with a Croatian twist, featuring nutty flavors from the cheese and roasted goodness from the lasagna.
instructions: Cook lasagna according to package instructions.
In a large mixing bowl, combine roasted cheese and nutty cheese.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, parmesan cheese, salt, and black pepper.
Spread a layer of cheese mixture on the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Arrange 4 lasagna sheets on top of the cheese mixture.
Spread half of the egg mixture over the lasagna sheets.
Sprinkle with half of the crumbled croatian cheese.
Repeat the layers: cheese mixture, lasagna sheets, egg mixture, and croatian cheese.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until golden brown.
Let it rest for 10-15 minutes before serving.
